title: Soup to go: mitigating forgetting during continual learning with model averaging

contributions.purpose: 在预训练 LLM 的持续学习(指令微调任务按序到来、只有当前任务数据可得)中缓解对早期任务的灾难性遗忘,且不承担存旧数据缓冲区、生成旧数据或每步存多份参数的开销
contributions.mechanism: 提出 Sequential Fine-tuning with Averaging(SFA):在新任务训练过程中,将当前正训练的模型与先前任务的 checkpoint 做模型平均(权重合并),再在新任务上继续训练;用先前 checkpoint 作为旧数据的代理,不需数据缓冲区或额外数据生成器
contributions.evaluation: 在 Pythia-2.8B 与 Llama-2-7B 上,跨 Math/Law/Code 领域按序微调;单个模型可同时在多个多样领域表现良好,扩展到 3 领域仍保持前 2 领域性能
contributions.domain: LLM 持续学习 / 模型合并(model merging)
contributions.source_quote: We introduce Sequential Fine-tuning Averaging (SFA), a method for mitigating forgetting by averaging model checkpoints from past tasks during fine-tuning on a new task.

contributions.purpose: 解释 SFA 为何有效,把模型合并与经典持续学习方法建立理论联系
contributions.mechanism: 分析证明 SFA 可理解为经典持续学习算法的近似——即在当前模型与过去任务 checkpoint 之间施加 L2 penalty;由此在 L2 penalty 与常用模型合并技术之间架桥
contributions.evaluation: 定性/理论分析,给出模型合并能有效缓解遗忘的直觉解释(无独立量化指标)
contributions.domain: LLM 持续学习 / 理论分析
contributions.source_quote: We show how SFA can be understood as an approximation of a classical continual learning algorithm: applying an L2 penalty between the current model and checkpoints from past tasks. This analysis bridges classical continual learning algorithms such as L2 penalty with commonly used model merging techniques

contributions.purpose: 验证 SFA 相对数据缓冲、经典惩罚法与其他合并技术的相对表现
contributions.mechanism: 跨任务/领域/模型对比 SFA 与 rehearsal(data buffer)、L2、Elastic Weight Consolidation、Task Arithmetic、TIES Merging
contributions.evaluation: SFA 达到与 rehearsal 相当(comparable)的结果而无需存旧数据,并优于 L2/EWC 及 Task Arithmetic/TIES;在 Math-then-Law 设置下 Task Arithmetic 与 TIES 完全无法保留 Math 性能,而 SFA(足够低的 p)可与 rehearsal 持平
contributions.domain: LLM 持续学习 / 实证对比
contributions.source_quote: our method achieves comparable results to using a data buffer, while outperforming other model merging techniques, as well as more classical continual learning methods.

self_declared_provenance.quote: our technique combines the intuition of continual learning with Rehearsal (Robins, 1995), Task Arithmetic (Ilharco et al., 2023) and Wise-FT (Wortsman et al., 2022b). However, unlike Rehearsal-based methods that store data in a buffer, we use a model fine-tuned on a past task/domain. Furthermore, unlike Task Arithmetic, our method merges a past checkpoint of a given model with the current model, rather than the task vectors from individual models.

while our method focuses on merging during actual fine-tuning and across tasks/domains, Wise-FT merges a pretrained and a fine-tuned model. In this way, our work generalizes Wise-FT throughout continual learning.
Inspired by a classical continual learning method-L2 penalty to previous weights-we propose Sequential Fine-tuning with Averaging (SFA)

notes: 关键的 comparable/平局与 trade-off 信号突出:SFA 对 rehearsal(数据缓冲上界/近上界)只是'comparable',并未超越;真正超越的是其他合并法(Task Arithmetic/TIES)与经典惩罚法(L2/EWC)。多任务同时微调(multitask)是不可达的上界(数据流式设定下不可行)。消融显示合并权重 p 与 β 存在明显 trade-off:SFA(p=1)在 β≥0.5 时 Math 与 Law 之间权衡剧烈、会完全丢失 Math,说明'训练过程中持续平均'(p<1)才是保持跨领域能力的关键。方法显式嫁接/推广 Rehearsal、Task Arithmetic、Wise-FT,并把自身定位为 L2 penalty 的近似。
